t: All Acts or parts of Acts inconsistent with this Act are hereby repealed; but nothing contained in this Act shall be construed to affect the continued application to the Coast Guard of the Act of July 24, 1941, as amended (34 U. S. C., Supp. V, secs. 350–350J).

fable.w: This is a repealer and savings clause: it repeals inconsistent Acts and preserves the application of a 1941 Act to the Coast Guard. There is no tempting reading here; no outside party is consulted, heard, appointed to a body, or given a right to sue over any federal decision. Nothing in the text crosses the federal boundary or describes any decision-making process at all.
fable.s: All Acts or parts of Acts inconsistent with this Act are hereby repealed

qwen_block.w: This section is a standard savings clause and repeal provision. It addresses the legal relationship between the current Act and previous statutes, specifically preserving the application of an older Act to the Coast Guard. It does not establish any process for consultation, coordination, or participation with entities outside the federal government.
qwen_block.s: All Acts or parts of Acts inconsistent with this Act are hereby repealed; but nothing contained in this Act shall be construed to affect the continued application to the Coast Guard of the Act of July 24, 1941, as amended (34 U. S. C., Supp. V, secs. 350–350J).

opus.w: This section only repeals laws that conflict with this Act and keeps the Act of July 24, 1941 in force for the Coast Guard. No one outside the federal government is consulted, given a hearing, or allowed to comment on or challenge a federal decision. Mentioning another Act's "continued application" does not, by itself, create any outside process.
